name: House of the Dragon: oh Geez!
author: UniVerseLessOne
description:
oh Geez! It's another House of the Dragon fanfic with the son of Daemon Targaryen and Rhea Royce as the MC.
So, hotdog...
And yeah... none of this is original. Credit to GRR Martin and whoever owns House of the Dragon stuff. This is just a fanfic and that's it.
No One 17 and Under Admitted

comments.content: Tis a bad novel, so I give it one stars... and I hope you give it one as well. It's just how it is with my fanfics, they're only deserving of one.
Moreeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee  obs:I only gave it 1 star because the author asked, because I think it deserves more.
Overall amazing story, if wasn't for the author wish for this fic to get 1star rated, would've rated bout 4-5star.
writing this again since author told to give one star but i want more more more

Hab your one star, write moar.
I am enjoying this. I'd like to see more of what he has built. I hope he builds paragliders instead of going after dragons like every other plebian si.

nice fic by the way.

I'd like to give it 5 stars, but since it was the author's request, here it is.
........................................
The story is good, in a very rational way. It doesn't have overpowered abilities like in Naruto; the power is based on effort. If you don't put in the effort, you'll become weak.
Recommend you all give it a read.
This is a magnificent story. Only giving it one star because the author asked for it. Otherwise even 5 stars wont be enough for this one. Sigh
Would be a pretty solid story if it toned down on the "Magical" aspect of the story.
It’s an impressive fanfic — just read it. I only have one thing to say: Absolute Cinema.............................................................
Best Game of Thrones Story I read in a while.
